WorkflowOperations.title: Workflow operations
WorkflowOperations.description: See what's running well, what's waiting, and where someone needs to step in.

access.title: You don't have access to workflows
access.body: Managing automation in this workspace needs an access level you don't have. Ask a workspace admin if you need it.

errors.title: Couldn't load workflow operations
errors.body: No numbers were made up — they just didn't arrive. Try again.
errors.mutationBody: The change may or may not have gone through. Refresh to see the current state before trying again.

triggerDiagnostics.title: Some triggers never reached their workflow
triggerDiagnostics.description: These triggers failed before any record was picked up. Each one stays listed until the same trigger succeeds again.

runs.title: Recent runs
runs.description: Every run this workspace has recorded, newest first.
runs.emptyBody: Change the status or reason filter to see other runs.

detail.missingBody: It doesn't exist in this workspace, or you no longer have access to it.
detail.retryDistinctionTitle: Retrying and starting a new run are different
detail.retryDistinctionBody: Retry picks this run back up at the step that failed, on the version it started with. A new run starts from the beginning, on the version that's live now.

path.title: What ran
path.description: Each row is what one step actually did, recorded as it happened — never guessed afterwards.
path.legacyBody: This run was carried over from an earlier automation, so only its summary was kept. Connex won't guess which steps it took.

signal.intake_paused: New records aren't being picked up. Anything already waiting stays where it is.
signal.workflow_disabled: New runs are off. Runs already going will finish.
signal.workflow_archived: This workflow is archived. Its history is still here.
signal.open_intervention: At least one run needs someone to step in.
signal.waiting_backlog: Runs are partway through, waiting out a delay.
signal.overdue_backlog: At least one waiting run is past due.

backlog.title: Waiting work
backlog.recentFailures: {count, plural, =0 {No recent failures} one {# recent failure} other {# recent failures}}

changes.title: Recent changes to this workflow
changes.description: Every published version is kept exactly as it was, so you can see how this workflow changed.
changes.empty: This workflow hasn't been published yet, so there's nothing to compare.

controls.title: Controls
controls.pauseHelp: Pausing stops new records from being picked up. Anything already waiting stays where it is.
controls.disableHelp: Turning this off stops new runs; runs already going will finish. Archiving is separate.

reason.actor_unavailable: The member this workflow runs as is no longer available.
reason.actor_inactive: The member this workflow runs as is no longer active.
reason.permission_denied: The member this workflow runs as lost a permission this step needed.
reason.action_permission_missing: The member this workflow runs as can't do what this step needs.
reason.reference_unavailable: Something this step points to — a tag, a stage, or a member — is gone.
reason.record_unavailable: The record this run was for is gone, or you can no longer see it.
reason.retry_exhausted: Connex retried this as many times as it's allowed to.
reason.retry_not_safe: This step can't be safely retried on its own.
reason.unknown: This version of Connex can't explain what went wrong. Reload the page, and tell support if it keeps happening.
reason.condition_matched: The record matched the stop conditions.
reason.date_superseded: The deal’s expected close date changed.
reason.task_wait_timeout: The task was not completed before its deadline.

retrySafety.deduplicated: Safe to retry, and it won't duplicate

manual.title: Run workflow
manual.description: Pick exactly which records to run this on, review the list, then start the run.
manual.distinctionBody: This isn't a retry. The workflow you pick runs from the beginning, on the version that's live now.
manual.noWorkflows: No published workflow works with this kind of record.

recipes.title: Workflow recipes
recipes.description: Start from a ready-made workflow. Each one shows who it runs as, what it reads, and what it changes.
recipes.emptyBody: Recipes are ready-made workflows you can start from. None are available right now — build one from scratch instead.
recipes.missingBody: It may have been renamed or removed. Go back and pick another one.
recipes.configureBody: Fill in the values below. The trigger and the steps themselves are fixed here — you can change them once the workflow exists.
recipes.exampleRecordHelp: Search for a visible record to preview the recipe. The preview does not make changes.
recipes.previewOnlyBody: Nothing is created or changed: no workflow, no run, and no task, note, activity, tag, or notification.
recipes.zeroWrites: Confirmed: nothing was created or changed.
recipes.unresolved: {count, plural, one {# required value is still empty} other {# required values are still empty}}.
recipes.validationBlocked: This workflow isn't ready to publish yet.
recipes.installHelp: Connex creates the workflow turned off and records which recipe it came from. Review it, then turn it on.
recipes.actionErrorBody: Nothing was created. Check the values above and try again.
recipes.disclosureBody: This stays with the workflow after you create it, so you can always see where it came from.
recipes.disableRemove: Turning it off, or removing it
recipes.disableBehavior: Turning it off stops new runs; runs already going will finish
recipes.removeBehavior: Removing it archives the workflow and keeps its versions and run history

person-job-change-follow-up.title: Follow up after a job change
person-job-change-follow-up.description: When a contact's employment changes, create a follow-up task for the owner you choose.

deal-won-handoff.title: Hand off a won deal
deal-won-handoff.description: When a deal is won, log the handoff and create a follow-up task for the owner you choose.

cooling-company-review.title: Review a cooling company
cooling-company-review.description: On a schedule, find companies whose warmth is cooling and create a task to check in.

person-qualified-routing.title: Route a contact to the right owner
person-qualified-routing.description: Assign a contact to the owner you choose and create a linked follow-up task.

deal-follow-through.title: Follow through on a deal
deal-follow-through.description: Create a follow-up task and wait for its completion before moving the deal to the stage you choose.

deal-renewal-preparation.title: Prepare for a renewal
deal-renewal-preparation.description: Use a deal’s expected close date to start a renewal task ahead of time and follow its completion.

recipes.renewalDateHelp: This recipe uses the deal’s expected close date. Set a negative day offset to start before that date, and enter an IANA time zone such as Asia/Tokyo or Pacific/Honolulu.
